commits.message: Every control and format code point has one disposition, read by the sanitizer and the width measure (rich-control-codes-xh4n.xt7)

chore(release): 0.28.0, and textual-ansi states only its bases (rich-unfiled-791c.01dl) (#532)

textual-ansi states only its bases, as 0.27.0's TerminalTheme was built from.
#531 gave TEXTUAL_ANSI the authored palette, whose data its generator had
flattened: every ladder rung was its root, panel was the background, the input
cursor was inverted. The file now states the eight bases and buildPalette
derives every other role, so TEXTUAL_ANSI.palette is role for role what 0.27.0
drew. A test walks every bundled ladder through its root; boost is left out,
being a layer.

Version 0.28.0. This commit does not publish; the tag v0.28.0 does.
